uploads_portrait_flow_check.name: uploads_portrait_flow_check
uploads_portrait_flow_check.value: "uploads"."kind" = 'card' or (not "uploads"."stage_only" and "uploads"."crop" is null and "uploads"."publish_requested_at" is null)

portraits_owner_check.name: portraits_owner_check
portraits_owner_check.value: ("portraits"."kind" = 'avatar' and "portraits"."user_id" is not null and "portraits"."league_id" is null) or ("portraits"."kind" = 'league' and "portraits"."league_id" is not null and "portraits"."user_id" is null)

cards_moment_fields_check.name: cards_moment_fields_check
cards_moment_fields_check.value: ("cards"."moment_selfie_upload_id" is null) = ("cards"."moment_taken_at" is null) and ("cards"."moment_taken_at" is null) = ("cards"."moment_late_minutes" is null)
